senses.sense_definition: A taxonomic rank used in biology that is below the level of species.

examples.text: Biologists often debate whether a specific population should be classified as a distinct <w>subspecies</w> or just a variation.
The classification system assigns a specific rank to each <w>subspecies</w> within the broader group.

senses.sense_definition: A group of organisms that belongs to a specific taxonomic rank below a species.

examples.text: This particular <w>subspecies</w> is found only in the remote islands of the Pacific.
Researchers identified a new <w>subspecies</w> of the tiger during their recent expedition.

senses.sense_definition: A subdivision or category within a larger scientific classification system.

examples.text: The mineral was categorized as a <w>subspecies</w> of the primary crystal structure.
Scientists analyzed the chemical properties of this <w>subspecies</w> to understand its formation.
